answered.sql: SELECT A.name, BT.type FROM Architects A JOIN Architects_Building_Types ABT ON A.id = ABT.architect_id JOIN Building_Types BT ON ABT.building_type_id = BT.id

candidates.meaning: Find the types of building types associated with each architect.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, BT.type FROM Architects A JOIN Architects_Building_Types ABT ON A.id = ABT.architect_id JOIN Building_Types BT ON ABT.building_type_id = BT.id

candidates.meaning: List the types of buildings each architect is associated with.
candidates.sql: SELECT a.name, bt.type FROM Architects a JOIN Architects_Building_Types abt ON a.id = abt.architect_id JOIN Building_Types bt ON abt.building_type_id = bt.id

candidates.meaning: Identify the building types that each architect has worked on, based on job postings.
candidates.sql: SELECT a.name, b.title, bt.type FROM Architects a JOIN Job_Postings b ON a.name = b.title AND b.title LIKE '%Architect%' JOIN Building_Types bt ON b.description LIKE '%Residential%' OR b.description LIKE '%Commercial%' OR b.description LIKE '%Industrial%' OR b.description LIKE '%Institutional%' OR b.description LIKE '%Mixed-Use%'

candidates.meaning: Find the building types associated with each architect based on their job postings and required skills.
candidates.sql: SELECT a.name, bt.type FROM Architects a JOIN Job_Postings b ON a.name = b.title AND b.title LIKE '%Architect%' JOIN Building_Types bt ON b.required_skills LIKE '%Residential%' OR b.required_skills LIKE '%Commercial%' OR b.required_skills LIKE '%Industrial%' OR b.required_skills LIKE '%Institutional%' OR b.required_skills LIKE '%Mixed-Use%'
